parameters.name: APIEnable
parameters.description: Enable or disable SMS API exposure on FAP

parameters.name: QueueEnable
parameters.description: Enable or disable Request queueing for the API

parameters.name: Queueing
parameters.description: Determines how FAP handles simultaneous requests from different Applications to SMS API.

parameters.name: MaxAPIUsersNumber
parameters.description: Determines the Max Number of different Applications that can send Requests to SMS API.

parameters.name: MinSendSMSTimeInterval
parameters.description: Determines the Minimum Time Interval in {{units}} between two consecutive Send SMS Requests by the same Application.

parameters.name: EnableQuerySMSDeliveryStatus
parameters.description: Enable or disable "QuerySMSDeliveryStatus" Operation on SMS API. When disabled, QuerySMSDeliveryStatus Requests to SMS API are ignored.

parameters.name: EnableSubscribeToNotificationsOfMessageSentToApplication
parameters.description: Enable or disable "SubscribeToNotificationsOfMessageSentToApplication" Operation on SMS API. When disabled, SubscribeTo NotificationsOfMessageSentToApplication Requests to SMS API are ignored.

object.description: This object contains parameters related to the SMS API.
